name: 08757 · Toms River, NJ
findings: ZIP 08757 (Toms River) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08757 (Toms River) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 08757 (Toms River) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
